name: 90266 · Manhattan Bch, CA
findings: ZIP 90266 (Manhattan Bch) has 206 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90266 (Manhattan Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90266 (Manhattan Bch) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
